analysis.headline: Citizen Lab finds spyware delivered via targeted ads
analysis.summary: Citizen Lab released evidence of mercenary zero-click spyware distributed through online ads, reportedly compromising Al Jazeera devices, in what outlets call the first confirmed such case; an Israeli adtech company is implicated, though only some reports name it.
